importedFrom.note: Imported from the rcap-render-worker-publication artifact emitted by successful workflow run 32256218245. The artifact blob host is unreachable from the integration environment, so the record was read from that run's job log, where the workflow cats the same JSON it uploads. Every field below is a verbatim copy of that emitted JSON except packageVisibility, registryPullByDigestStatus and registryPullByDigestNote, which are recorded here and are described in the note.

packageVisibilityNote: Determined, not copied forward. GHCR issued no anonymous pull token for this repository, while two known-public GHCR repositories (actions/actions-runner, oras-project/oras) issued one over the same network path in the same check, so the refusal is the package's visibility rather than a blocked route.
registryPullByDigestNote: What is proven: read-only run 32256682048 asked GHCR directly and the full-SHA tag 1048d82e resolves to sha256:62a4fa30, that digest exists, no mutable latest tag exists, and the superseded digest sha256:be782397 still exists but is NOT the tag target — so nothing was moved. The Dockerfile and lockfile hashes the publication recorded were recomputed from the tree at 1048d82e and match byte for byte. What is NOT yet proven, and is deliberately not claimed here: an authenticated layer pull, fail-closed startup, the health command, and the secret scans. .github/workflows/rcap-worker-image-acceptance.yml performs all four against this exact digest; GitHub will not dispatch a workflow_dispatch workflow until it is present on the default branch, so that run happens once this integration merges and before any Preview or Production step. The prior record for 664b8ddd asserted those four in prose against a run number with nothing in the repository that could perform them; this field states only what has a run behind it.

supersededPublication.why: Built from bytes that are not image-input-equivalent to this release head; its digest remains in the registry under its own full-SHA tag and was confirmed not to be the target of this release's tag.
